svg.title: A notice on a subscription
svg.desc: The core system opens a subscription. When the external system sends an event, the ambassador translates and sanitises it, records it in the journal and sends a notice to the core system. A notice is a fact, never a command. Subscribe: 1. Core system sends to Ambassador: open subscription. An event arrives: 2. External system sends to Ambassador: external event. 3. Ambassador sends to Ambassador: translate, sanitise. 4. Ambassador sends to Journal: record. Tell the core: 5. Ambassador sends to Core system: notice.
